description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Syndra''' telekinetically grabs the nearest ''[[File:Syndra Dark Sphere.png|20xpx|border|link=Syndra#Dark Sphere|An icon for Syndra's ability Dark Sphere]] [[Syndra#Dark Sphere|Dark Sphere]]'', enemy [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minion]] or non-epic [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monster]] within 500 units from the target location, and holds the target near her for 5 seconds. If a ''Dark Sphere'' is grabbed, its duration is refreshed; if a minion or monster is grabbed, it is put in [[File:Stasis icon.png|20px|link=Types_of_Crowd_Control#Stasis|An icon representing the keyword Stasis]] [[:Types_of_Crowd_Control#Stasis|stasis]]. She prioritizes grabbing the nearest unit, then ''[[File:Syndra Dark Sphere.png|20xpx|border|link=Syndra#Dark Sphere|An icon for Syndra's ability Dark Sphere]] [[Syndra#Dark Sphere|Dark Spheres]]''.
description.text: Active: Syndra telekinetically grabs the nearest Dark Sphere, enemy minion or non-epic monster within 500 units from the target location, and holds the target near her for 5 seconds. If a Dark Sphere is grabbed, its duration is refreshed; if a minion or monster is grabbed, it is put in stasis. She prioritizes grabbing the nearest unit, then Dark Spheres.

description2.raw: ''Force of Will'' can be recast while the target is being held.
description2.text: Force of Will can be recast while the target is being held.

description3.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Syndra''' throws the grabbed target towards the target location, granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of their surroundings as they fall and dealing magic damage to them and nearby enemies once they land. All targets hit are [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] by 25% for 1.5 seconds.
description3.text: Recast: Syndra throws the grabbed target towards the target location, granting sight of their surroundings as they fall and dealing magic damage to them and nearby enemies once they land. All targets hit are slowed by 25% for 1.5 seconds.

description4.raw: '''[[File:Syndra Transcendent.png|20xpx|border|link=Syndra#Transcendent|An icon for Syndra's ability Transcendent]] [[Syndra#Transcendent|Transcendent]] Bonus:''' Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances ''Force of Will'' to deal [[File:Hybrid penetration icon.png|15px|link=True damage]] 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) '''bonus''' true damage.
description4.text: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal  12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.

'''Magic Damage:'''
70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 (+ 65% AP)

8.4 / 12 / 15.6 / 19.2 / 22.8 (+ 9.2 / 9.8 / 10.4 / 11 / 11.6% AP) '''(+ 1.14% AP)2'''

notes.raw: * The initial cast does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. **Detonating the ability manually does. * If the ability is not recast within the duration, '''Syndra''' will release the unit or ''Dark Sphere'' that she is holding. * ''Force of Will'' does not destroy in-flight [[File:Projectile.png|20px|link=Projectile|An icon representing the keyword Projectile]] [[:Projectile|projectiles]] for the [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minion]] or [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monster]] grabbed. * ''Force of Will'' [[File:Remove Scurvy.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Removal|An icon representing the keyword Cleanse]] [[:Crowd control#Removal|cleanses]] the target [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minion]] or [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monster]] grabbed from all [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control|An icon representing the keyword Crowd control]] [[:Crowd control|crowd control]]. * ''Force of Will'' prevents non-sphere targets from dying when picking them up. * If the the thrown target was a [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monster]], it is [[File:Taunt icon.png|20px|link=Taunt|An icon representing the keyword Taunt]] [[:Taunt|taunted]] for 0.25 seconds after landing. * '''Syndra''' can grab [[File:Summon Tibbers.png|20px|link=Pets|An icon representing the keyword Pet]] [[:Pets|pets]], such as [[File:Shaco OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Shaco|An icon representing Shaco]] [[Shaco|Shaco's]] [[File:Shaco Jack in the Box.png|20xpx|border|link=Shaco#Jack in the Box|An icon for Shaco's ability Jack in the Box]] [[Shaco#Jack in the Box|Jack in the Box]]. * Casting [[File:Teleport.png|20xpx|border|link=Teleport|An icon representing Teleport]] [[Teleport]] or [[File:Recall.png|20xpx|border|link=Recall|An icon representing Recall]] [[Recall]], or switching realms ([[File:Mordekaiser OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Mordekaiser|An icon representing Mordekaiser]] [[Mordekaiser|Mordekaiser's]] [[File:Mordekaiser Realm of Death.png|20xpx|border|link=Mordekaiser#Realm of Death|An icon for Mordekaiser's ability Realm of Death]] [[Mordekaiser#Realm of Death|Realm of Death]]) will cause '''Syndra''' to cancel ''Force of Will'' autonomously and drop anything she is holding. * Grabbing prioritizes ''Dark Spheres''. * Enemy [[File:Summon Tibbers.png|20px|link=Pets|An icon representing the keyword Pet]] [[:Pets|pets]] that passively have an effect on their surroundings will continue to affect the area around them while they are being held. For example, [[File:Annie OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Annie|An icon representing Annie]] [[Annie|Annie's]] [[File:Annie Summon- Tibbers.png|20xpx|border|link=Annie#Summon: Tibbers|An icon for Annie's ability Summon: Tibbers]] [[Annie#Summon: Tibbers|Tibbers]] will continue to inflict burn damage on surrounding units while being held. * Grabbing a [[File:Syndra Dark Sphere.png|20xpx|border|link=Syndra#Dark Sphere|An icon for Syndra's ability Dark Sphere]] [[Syndra#Dark Sphere|Dark Sphere]] will cause the duration on it to refresh, but only on the first cast, not when it is thrown. * ''Force of Will'' has additional effects when targeting the [[File:Blue SentinelSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Blue Sentinel|An icon representing Blue Sentinel]] [[Blue Sentinel]] and [[File:Red BramblebackSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Red Brambleback|An icon representing Red Brambleback]] [[Red Brambleback]]. Throwing the former will refund 10 [[File:Mana resource.png|20px|link=Mana|An icon representing the keyword Mana]] [[:Mana|mana]] to '''Syndra''' upon cast and will reduce the [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown of ''Force of Will'' by 1 second, while throwing the latter will apply the [[File:Crest of Cinders buff.png|20xpx|border|link=Crest of Cinders|An icon representing the Crest of Cinders neutral buff]] [[Crest of Cinders]] burn to any affected units in the [[area of effect]]. * ''Force of Will's'' first cast uses a [[File:Force of Will 3.png|20px|link=]] modified icon while it has the [[File:Syndra Transcendent.png|20xpx|border|link=Syndra#Transcendent|An icon for Syndra's ability Transcendent]] [[Syndra#Transcendent|Transcendent]] bonus.
notes.text:
The initial cast does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
*Detonating the ability manually does.
If the ability is not recast within the duration, Syndra will release the unit or Dark Sphere that she is holding.
Force of Will does not destroy in-flight projectiles for the minion or monster grabbed.
Force of Will cleanses the target minion or monster grabbed from all crowd control.
Force of Will prevents non-sphere targets from dying when picking them up.
If the the thrown target was a monster, it is taunted for 0.25 seconds after landing.
Syndra can grab pets, such as Shaco's Jack in the Box.
Casting Teleport or Recall, or switching realms ( Mordekaiser's Realm of Death) will cause Syndra to cancel Force of Will autonomously and drop anything she is holding.
Grabbing prioritizes Dark Spheres.
Enemy pets that passively have an effect on their surroundings will continue to affect the area around them while they are being held. For example, Annie's Tibbers will continue to inflict burn damage on surrounding units while being held.
Grabbing a Dark Sphere will cause the duration on it to refresh, but only on the first cast, not when it is thrown.
Force of Will has additional effects when targeting the Blue Sentinel and Red Brambleback. Throwing the former will refund 10 mana to Syndra upon cast and will reduce the  cooldown of Force of Will by 1 second, while throwing the latter will apply the Crest of Cinders burn to any affected units in the area of effect.
Force of Will's first cast uses a modified icon while it has the Transcendent bonus.
